# What should you charge to pump this grease trap?

> Free grease trap pumping bid calculator: enter the trap, truck, dump trip, labour and disposal fee, and get a price per visit, the pump-out interval under the 25 percent rule and the annual price by interval. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/grease-trap-pumping-price-calculator/)
